title: 陣頭 Tīn-thâu
mood: seen by your mother for once
subject: a troupe of young labourers who become temple procession dancers once a year
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien festival EDM in the electric flower-car lineage of temple-procession party music. A long festival EDM build with temple drum and gong samples woven into the rhythm, a bright supersaw lead melody, a heavy sub bass and four-on-the-floor kick at the drop, firecracker-like snare rolls into each chorus. Big festival sound, loud and celebratory, with the temple percussion audible inside the electronic production. Male voice singing a melodic Taigi hook over the drop, warm and unpretentious. 126 BPM, F minor. Seen by your mother for once. No ballad section, no trap drums, no enka-style weeping, no acoustic guitar, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
透早五點 廟口集合 面畫甲紅紅白白
阮是陣頭 毋過平常時 阮是做工的少年
扛轎的 拍鼓的 放炮的 攏是厝邊的囡仔
一冬一擺 阮變做 神明的跤手

[Chorus]
陣頭 陣頭
鑼鼓聲一下響 規條街攏停
平常時 無人看阮
今仔日 規庄 攏咧等阮

[Verse]
阿母佇路邊 拍噗仔 伊共手機仔舉懸懸
伊平常時 嫌阮頭毛 染甲黃黃
今仔日 伊共厝邊講「彼个 是阮後生」
阮聽著 阮的跤步 煞踏甲較大步

[Chorus]
陣頭 陣頭
鑼鼓聲一下響 規條街攏停
平常時 無人看阮
今仔日 阮阿母 嘛咧看阮

[Outro]
暗時 洗面
紅的 白的 流落去
